skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and theories related to operations management, including production, services, and process design.
Understand the concepts and theories related to strategic operations management.
Apply various methods in operations management to make decisions and solve practical problems.
Analyze case studies and practical examples in operations management to solve problems.
Combine experience, knowledge, and tools to demonstrate problem-solving skills in operations management.
Manage and coordinate group projects and presentations effectively.
Participate in discussions, answer questions, and present research findings effectively.
Lead group discussions and presentations, and actively contribute to group activities.
Work effectively in teams, share ideas, and support group members.
Prepare and deliver presentations with clear structure, logical content, and professional format.
Conduct research, gather data, and analyze information to support group projects.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class activities.
Make ethical decisions and demonstrate professional behavior in all activities.
